decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The bollards shown on Amended drawing 24059/111 Rev C (Boundary Treatment, Refuse Collection Limits and Sightlines) shall be provided before the car parking spaces towards the four spaces north of, and the three spaces south of, the bin and recycle store are first brought into use.

Condition : 2 - No dig' construction methods in accordance with BS5837 - Trees in Relation to Construction - shall be used where the parking layout (given that the access road itself is substantially complete) hereby approved infringes the protected zone of any retained tree/s.  A detailed drawing showing the recommended construction of the 'no dig' parking spaces within the root protection area of the retained tree/s (complete with methods of increasing soil levels where necessary) shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority before those parking spaces are first constructed.
description: Following approval for a redesigned scheme:  The demolition of all additions and structures, retaining the original villa, 28 The Grove.  The conversion of the villa to provide 5 flats and a three storey extension to provide a further 6 flats.  The erection of a three-storey terrace of 6 houses to the rear of the site - details submitted pursuant to Condition 12 (Access Road Details) of approved planning permission ref 00523/28/P5 dated 23/12/2005.
